scope: All email-generating agents on Mac and GCP; 3x scan-fix-verify cycles

issues_found.title: GCP integrity agent firing false HIGH alert every 2 hours
issues_found.detail: pipeline_heartbeat.json exists on GCP (written by a historical main.py test run on May 14, age 26h+). manager_decisions.json does NOT exist on GCP. The GCP-skip logic at line 179 only triggered when BOTH files were missing — so it fell through to Pattern 2 (heartbeat stale on weekday = HIGH), appending a HIGH entry to chairman_action_required.json every 2 hours.

issues_found.title: _HEARTBEAT_STALE_H = 16h threshold too tight for Mac sleep cycles
issues_found.detail: Mac pipeline runs at ~4:15 PM. If the next cron check on Mac is at 8:50 AM the next day (~16.6h later), it would flip from OK to HIGH alert. The correct threshold should be 26h (covers a full missed day with 2h buffer before alarming).

issues_found.title: VIX data unavailable during market hours escalated to ORANGE (full cascade)
issues_found.detail: A Yahoo Finance API blip during market hours with vix_level=None was coded (CIT-2026-268) to escalate to ORANGE, which triggers the full emergency cascade: CRO bulletin, Review Agent, Manager Agent, Board Meeting — all from a data feed failure. This produced false board meetings and emails whenever yfinance was slow.

issues_found.title: IRM REVIEW prefix doubles every buffered email in the digest
issues_found.detail: trigger_irm_review() is called after every successfully buffered email. The board panel always has combined_red_flags which passes the 'meaningful' gate, so every email gets a [IRM REVIEW] companion queued to the buffer. The buffer had 200 entries (pre-clear) of which ~100 were [IRM REVIEW] copies. Does NOT cause immediate emails — only inflates the daily digest.
issues_found.note: Expected design behavior — IRM reviews all emails. Volume issue only.

issues_found.title: Morning briefing alert string mentions DEAD-MAN'S SWITCH at 30h threshold
issues_found.detail: At line 378, if manager_decisions.json is >30h old, morning_briefing adds 'DEAD-MAN'S SWITCH risk' to briefing alerts. This goes into the briefing email (buffered, not urgent) and is appropriate context — not a false alarm source.

issues_found.title: ML daily brief uses send_alert_email (bypasses buffer) for a routine report
issues_found.detail: ml_research_team_leader.py uses send_alert_email() for its daily briefing email, sending it as an immediate raw SMTP message outside the buffer/digest system. Subject is '📊 Apex Capital — ML Research Team Daily Brief' which is non-urgent. Not a false alert but causes an extra daily email outside the digest.

issues_found.title: Premarket check has no dedup — could send daily VIX alert if persistently elevated
issues_found.detail: premarket_check.py sends immediately (subject has ⚠️ which is in URGENT_PATTERNS) when VIX > 25 or SPY gap < -1.5%. No cooldown or deduplication. If VIX stays elevated for multiple consecutive mornings, Chairman receives a HIGH email each day. This is correct alert behavior but worth noting.

fixes_applied.description: Added explicit GCP skip guard: if manager_decisions.json does NOT EXIST (never written) on this host, skip the DMS check entirely. This covers the case where pipeline_heartbeat.json exists from a past test run but manager_decisions.json was never written — the normal GCP steady-state.

Raised _HEARTBEAT_STALE_H from 16 to 26 hours. The Mac pipeline runs once at ~4:15 PM. A 26h threshold means the alert only fires if the pipeline has missed more than one full day — appropriate for catching genuine multi-day outages without false-alarming on overnight Mac sleep.

Changed VIX data-unavailable behavior during market hours from ORANGE to YELLOW. ORANGE triggered the full emergency cascade (CRO + Review + Manager + Board) on a Yahoo Finance API blip. YELLOW logs the gap and increases monitoring sensitivity without waking agents. All other triggers (SPY, QQQ, positions, sector breadth) still fire independently.
Cleared the stale HIGH entry in chairman_action_required.json on GCP that was written by the pre-fix run at 22:50 UTC on 2026-05-15.

gcp_integrity_run_1.note: 1 stale entry from pre-fix run; cleared immediately

gcp_integrity_run_2.issues_found: MEDIUM×1 (risk_bulletin.json 27h old — does NOT escalate to chairman)
gcp_integrity_run_2.check_1_dms: SKIPPED — correctly identified as GCP host

gcp_integrity_run_2.check_4_ml: PASS — model not yet trained, no AUC to check

remaining_risks.description: GCP pipeline_heartbeat.json will continue aging. Once it reaches >26h (already at 26.6h), Check 3 agent freshness flags risk_bulletin.json as MEDIUM. This is correct behavior but if it ever reaches exactly the threshold of a future alert on Mac, the MacOS DMS check at line 202 could trigger. On Mac, manager_decisions.json WILL exist, so the GCP guard (FIX-001) won't help — but Mac has the 26h threshold guard (FIX-002) which allows a full missed-day before alarming.
remaining_risks.mitigation: FIX-002 (26h threshold) is sufficient. The Mac pipeline runs daily so heartbeat will reset each cycle.

remaining_risks.description: IRM REVIEW email doubling in the digest is expected by design but inflates daily digest volume. If the board panel always surfaces red flags, every single buffered email doubles. This does not cause immediate alerts but makes the daily digest noisy.
remaining_risks.mitigation: Accepted design tradeoff. The board panel red-flag gate could be tightened (only send IRM review if red_flags > 0, NOT including board_panel flags). Not fixed in this audit — separate improvement.

remaining_risks.description: ml_research_team_leader.py sends via send_alert_email() (bypasses buffer) — its subject does not match URGENT_PATTERNS so it won't be deduped or buffered. Arrives as a raw SMTP email outside the digest system every day from GCP.
remaining_risks.mitigation: Switch to send_daily_report() in a follow-up fix. Low urgency — not a false alert.

remaining_risks.description: canary_agent.py VIX ORANGE downgraded to YELLOW. If VIX data is genuinely unavailable for multiple consecutive 5-minute canary cycles (not just a momentary blip), the system will only log YELLOW. Other triggers (SPY, positions) must still fire ORANGE independently. Acceptable: a data feed outage alone should not trigger a cascade.
remaining_risks.mitigation: Accepted tradeoff. SPY data unavailability separately raises to YELLOW (already existing logic at line 323), and position losses fire ORANGE independently.

verdict_notes: The three false-alert sources have been identified and fixed. The primary source (GCP integrity agent firing HIGH every 2 hours into chairman_action_required.json) is neutralized. The canary ORANGE-on-VIX-data-failure is corrected. The heartbeat threshold is raised to tolerate Mac sleep cycles. Chairman queue is empty. Email buffer is empty. Remaining issues are MEDIUM/LOW and do not reach the chairman.
